p: set thee on high above all: He will make you the most excellent of all people.
overtake thee: When you think you are forsaken.
city: You will live richly.
of thy body: Your children and succession.
comest in: All your enterprises will have good success.
seven ways: Meaning many ways.
hand unto: God will bless us, if we do our duty and are not idle.
called by the name of the: In that he is your God, and you are his people.
heaven to give the rain unto: For nothing in the earth is profitable but when God sends his blessings from heaven.
brass: It will give you no more moisture than if it were of brass.
Some read, you shall be a terror and fear, when they hear how God has plagued you.
carcase shall be meat unto all: You will be cursed both in your life and in your death: for the burial is a testimony of the resurrection a sign you will lack because of your wickedness.
blind gropeth in darkness: In things most evident and clear you will lack discretion and judgment.
shall look: When they will return from their captivity.
king which thou shalt set over: As he did Manasseh, Joiakim, Zedekiah and others.
shall the locust consume: Under one kind he contains all the vermin, which destroy the fruit of the land: and this is an evident token of God's curse.
woman among you: As came to pass in the days of Joram king of Israel, 2Ki 6:28 and when the Romans besieged Jerusalem.
young one that cometh out from: Hunger will so bite her, that she will be ready to eat her child before it is delivered.
all the words of this law: For he that offends in one, is guilty of all, Jas 2:10
written in the book of this: Declaring, that God has infinite means to plague the wicked, besides those that are ordinary or written.
scatter thee among all people: Signifying that it is a singular gift from God to be in a place where we may worship God purely and declare our faith and religion.
ships: Because they were unmindful of that miracle, when the sea made room for them to pass through.
